description: Typed structured note drafts authored by the agent. compose_notes.py validates drafts against these rules, resolves evidence to source locators, and writes normalized notes.jsonl.

rules: the agent's own statement in its own words; if claim is identical to an evidence quote after normalization, the note is flagged with the excerpt_only warning (a warning, not a rejection)
the referenced annotation must carry anchored_text of >= 8 chars after normalization, a valid integer page, and a non-empty file; the locator (file, page, quote) is taken from the annotation
file: non-empty string, matches a sources/<filekey>/ directory
quote: verbatim text, >= 8 chars after Unicode NFKC + whitespace-collapse normalization

annotation_ids: sorted unique annotation ids referenced by this note (note -> annotation correspondence)

correspondence.note_to_annotations: the annotation_ids field of each normalized note
correspondence.annotation_to_notes: printed in the compose_notes.py stdout summary, including unreferenced annotations

validation_outcomes.exit 3: at least one invalid draft; every offending note_id with its reasons is listed on stderr; notes.jsonl is NOT written
validation_outcomes.exit 2: usage or IO error (missing file, malformed JSONL, duplicate annotation_id, ...)

verification_rule.description: verify_claims.py normalizes quote and page text identically (Unicode NFKC, then collapse all whitespace runs to a single space, strip) and requires substring containment in sources/<file>/page-NNN.txt
verification_rule.gate: exit 3 unless every claim is verified
